buckets.label: Downlights
buckets.hint: Recessed into the ceiling. The everyday light for a room.

buckets.label: Ceiling lights
buckets.hint: Surface mounted, for concrete ceilings, rentals and low voids.

buckets.label: Panels
buckets.hint: Flat low glare light for offices, shops and studies.

buckets.label: Battens
buckets.hint: Linear surface fittings. Cheap even light for garages and sheds.

buckets.label: Track & linear
buckets.hint: Aimed light for artwork, islands and retail displays.

buckets.label: Wall lights
buckets.hint: Up and down the wall. Adds the layer downlights cannot.

buckets.label: Strip & cove
buckets.hint: Under benches, in coves and along stairs. Sold per metre.

buckets.label: Star lights
buckets.hint: Tiny 3 W points. An effect, not the light for the room.

buckets.label: Fans
buckets.hint: One per room, centred. A fan with a light does both jobs.

buckets.label: Bathroom
buckets.hint: Exhaust fans, bathroom mates and heat lamps.

buckets.label: Garden & path
buckets.hint: Spike lights, bollards and path lighting for outside.

buckets.label: Flood & sensor
buckets.hint: Driveways, yards and security. Wide, bright, weatherproof.

buckets.label: Emergency & exit
buckets.hint: Required in commercial fit-outs. No lighting effect shown.
